name: – Recital H – Am 1/1
title: Resolution on continued financial and military support to Ukraine by EU Member States
part_text: H.whereas the Hungarian Government issued a decree in breach of the Temporary Protection Directive1, cancelling state-funded shelter for refugees from western Ukraine, leaving many, the majority women and children, including members of Hungarian minorities, homeless; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1. Council Directive 2001/55/EC of 20 July 2001 on minimum standards for giving temporary protection in the event of a mass influx of displaced persons and on measures promoting a balance of efforts between Member States in receiving such persons and bearing the consequences thereof, OJ L 212, 7.8.2001, p. 12, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2001/55/oj.
